description: This file defines the RelationsDatasource class, which manages and provides data related to entity relations in an Angular application. It handles fetching, filtering, selection, and state management of entity relation data, utilizing RxJS observables and Angular CDK collections.

classes.name: RelationsDatasource
classes.description: A data source class for managing entity relation data, supporting loading, filtering, selection, and state management in an Angular application.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Returns an observable stream of entity relation data for collection viewer.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Completes internal subjects to clean up resources.

methods.name: loadRelations
methods.description: Loads relations based on direction, entity ID, and pagination, with optional reload.

methods.name: fetchRelations
methods.description: Fetches relations and applies pagination filtering.

methods.name: getAllRelations
methods.description: Retrieves all relations for a given direction and entity ID, with caching.

methods.name: isAllSelected
methods.description: Checks if all relations are selected.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the relation list is empty.
